android.// buildType: APK rather than the default AAB: an AAB has to go through a store to install, and this build exists to be sideloaded onto a phone from a link.

env.// note: EXPO_PUBLIC_* values are read from apps/mobile/.env at bundle time by the dev server, not baked in here -- a dev client loads its JS from the machine running `expo start`.

preview.// note: A shareable build with no dev tooling: what a client installs to try the app before it reaches a store.

production.// note: Store submission. AAB for Play, which is what Google requires.
